Ireland Defeats South Africa in Nations Championship Rugby

Ireland defeated South Africa 20-17 in a Nations Championship rugby match at Aviva stadium. The match has been described as a thriller, with Ireland stunning the double World Cup champions. France will play South Africa in the Nations Championship rugby final.
